caption: The drawing depicts a single figure seated on a simple, rectangular wooden bench with visible wood grain and pegs at the joints. The figure appears to be a puppet or doll, with an exaggerated, toothy grin, large eyes, and sharply defined facial features highlighted by dark outlines. The figure is dressed in a long, loose black garment with long sleeves and a high neckline, decorated with a string of purple beads around the neck and down the front. The hands and bare feet are colored a pale cream or ash hue. Around the neck is a black ribbon tied in a bow. The figure sits with the right leg crossed over the left, and both hands rest on its lap. The background is primarily off-white with a soft purple and grey wash behind the figure, suggesting a shadow or backdrop. In the foreground beneath the bench, there is a bow and an arrow, both rendered in brown and cream tones, with the bowstring and fletching details faintly visible. The drawing is signed “MABEL G. CLAFLIN—TAOS—N.M.” in the bottom right corner.
title: Figure of Death "Muerto"
